description:
## Goal

Separate diagnostic provenance from executable semantic identity before live source replacement is exposed. A location-only edit updates current diagnostics while equal backend and native content retains its allocation and generation.

## Authority

Executable products own semantic and runtime content. Immutable SourceVersion owners retain diagnostic locations. Program-visible quote metadata is ordinary semantic data and remains exact; incidental spans, rendered names and source offsets never identify executable content.

Do not omit spans from equality while returning an old span-bearing object. Instead, make each consumer request the semantic or diagnostic projection it actually owns. Do not add an artifact mirror, provenance repair pass or display-string key.

## TDD

On the existing SourceOwner and SourceVersion foundation, prove equal content at a different location preserves semantic facts, lowered bodies, products, native bodies and artifacts while current diagnostics and explicitly observed quote metadata name the correct version. A real content change moves only exact readers. Retained old closures, diagnostics and artifacts retain their old immutable provenance.

Measure allocations, generations, macro-result wakes, lowering and codegen. Location-only semantic work is zero.

## Deletion and acceptance

Delete span-coupled executable equality, duplicate provenance mirrors, location-derived callable identity, compatibility adapters and stale documentation. This is a prerequisite of live replacement, not work performed after replacement. Full focused, three-door, deterministic, documentation, formatting, check and strict-Clippy gates pass; fresh ticket-scoped cold review precedes one commit and close.
title: Separate diagnostic provenance from retained executable content identity
